result.summary: The image shows a wide one-way urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a well-maintained sidewalk. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and lighting are present, the multi-lane configuration and lack of visible pedestrian signals increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Multi-lane one-way traffic
hazards.description: The wide, one-way street design can encourage higher vehicle speeds and multiple-threat crashes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow them to include a bike lane, slowing traffic and reducing crossing distance.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals but presents a wide, multi-lane crossing that increases pedestrian exposure. The lack of a median or refuge island in such a large intersection creates a high-stress environment for people crossing on foot.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corners appear designed for high-speed vehicle turns, which reduces visibility and safety for pedestrians at the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The environment features wide roadways with multiple lanes and significant building setbacks, creating a car-oriented feel. While sidewalks are present and separated from traffic by greenery, the lack of marked crosswalks at the immediate intersection increases pedestrian risk.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalk markings at a wide intersection increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, open road design encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the foreground pavement could present a minor trip hazard.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide one-way urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the multi-lane configuration and parked vehicles near the crossing may impact safety and visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Multi-lane Roadway
hazards.description: The three-lane one-way configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds and increases the exposure time for pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Repurpose one travel lane or part of the roadway for a protected bike lane to narrow the street and provide a buffer.
